glossary.definition: (1) "Insurance agent" includes a limited lines insurance agent, surety bail bond agent, and surplus line broker.
glossary.scope: (A) As used in sections 3905.14 to 3905.16 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (2) "Refusal to issue or renew" means the decision of the superintendent of insurance not to process either the initial application for a license as an agent or the renewal of such a license.
glossary.scope: (A) As used in sections 3905.14 to 3905.16 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (3) "Revocation" means the permanent termination of all authority to hold any license as an agent in this state.
glossary.scope: (A) As used in sections 3905.14 to 3905.16 of the Revised Code:

glossary.definition: (4) "Surrender for cause" means the voluntary termination of all authority to hold any license as an agent in this state, in lieu of a revocation or suspension order.
